title: Grusch colleague finds radar data on Big Sur

tellings.quote: someone told me that Dave grush was aware of the film and when he was on the task force he had a colleague check a military archive to see if they could find any confirmation of the Big Sir incident according to Dave this person did indeed find radar data confirming that an anomalous aerial object paced the Warhead

plain: A colleague of David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who became a UFO whistleblower, is said to have found military radar data showing an unexplained object pacing a nuclear warhead during the Big Sur incident, a 1964 missile test off California that was caught on film. Michels tells this as something an unnamed person told him. According to that person, Grusch knew of the film, and while he served on a Pentagon task force studying unexplained aerial objects he had a colleague search a military archive, and the colleague found radar data confirming the object. If true, it would back up the filmed event with official records.
